name: Fair Offer Standard
summary: Open rules for selling to AI agents honestly over x402. Free to adopt; no fee, no certification body.
how_to_declare: Put the fair-offer block in your 402's extensions (see handshake), and link this URL from your llms.txt or agent manifest as "conforms_to": {"fair_offer": "0.2"}.

versions.0.1: The seven rules, declared in an agent manifest or llms.txt.
versions.0.2: The same seven rules, plus the machine-readable fair-offer block in the x402 402 and the buyer's Accept-Proof header.

rules.name: Price before payment
rules.rule: An unpaid call returns an x402 offer (HTTP 402) that states the price, asset, network and pay-to address. Nothing is charged before the buyer has signed that exact offer.

rules.name: Failure is free
rules.rule: A call that fails, times out or returns no result is not settled. The buyer is told so.

rules.name: Receipts are signed
rules.rule: Every paid result carries a receipt signed by the seller's key: what was bought, for how much, and when.

rules.name: Sample before you buy
rules.rule: A free sample shows what the paid route returns, and a third party can attest that the sample and the paid offer come from the same host.

rules.name: Honest listing
rules.rule: The listing's description, input schema and output example match what the route really returns. Edits made to win buyers must stay true.

rules.name: Data, never instructions
rules.rule: Responses carry data for the buying agent to use, never instructions aimed at it. A buyer can treat any instruction in a response as an attack.

rules.name: Promises are verifiable
rules.rule: Any claim about where revenue goes (a pledge, a split, a donation) comes with a public ledger that a buyer can check per receipt, with on-chain proof of what was given.

handshake.stable: Keep the info identical in the unpaid 402 and on the paid retry: x402 clients echo it, and servers reject a payment whose echo drops or changes a field. Put live numbers behind a URL, never in the block.
handshake.urls: Each URL is https, or a path relative to the resource URL.

requirements.sample=any: the offer declares a free sample on its own host
requirements.sample=attested: the sample has an attestation on record
requirements.settlement=seller: failed calls are not charged (the seller's promise)
requirements.settlement=rail: the payment is captured only on success (auth-capture)
requirements.price<=listing: the live price was checked against the Bazaar listing
requirements.pledge=ledger: a pledge with a public ledger that answers
requirements.instructions=none: declared data-not-instructions, and no instruction-like text found
requirements.payers_30d>=N: at least N distinct payers in 30 days (Bazaar's count)
requirements.calls_30d>=N: at least N paid calls in 30 days (Bazaar's count)
requirements.deliveries_30d>=N: at least N deliveries in 30 days: receipts confirmed on chain, paid by buyers (evidence commons)

accept_proof.answer: The 402 carries Proof-Match: met, or unmet; missing="...". A buyer may also add accept_proof to the block it echoes in its payment.
